hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Prediction market hook implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees. Every swap requires a backend-signed oracle sigma parameter; fees are computed as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]−1 and redistributed to prediction market share holders via a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs. Liquidity and swaps are blocked once the market is resolved or disputed.
